title: What if the Moon shattered?
premise: The Moon suddenly breaks into pieces. A hypothetical scenario, told in chapters.

intro.title: What if the *Moon* shattered?
intro.subtitle: A HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO · NOT A FORECAST

beats.caption: A calm night. The Moon hangs where it always has.

tooltip.label: FACT
tooltip.text: Sound can't travel through space. It would break apart in total silence.

beats.caption: Then, without any warning, it breaks apart.
Billions of people look up at the same impossible sight.
Scientists race to track every fragment.

tooltip.label: REAL EVENT
tooltip.text: Chelyabinsk, 2013: a ~20 m space rock exploded over Russia and injured about 1,500 people.

beats.caption: Small fragments start falling as shooting stars.
The debris slowly spreads into a ring around Earth.

stat.label: OF EARTH'S TIDES ARE DRIVEN BY THE MOON

beats.caption: Spread into a ring, its pull no longer raises tides the same way.
For 4.5 billion years, the Moon lit our nights.
Now it's gone, and Earth would never be the same.
